Reporting focus

Services
How I help
Practical reporting solutions for UK health and wellness operators. Built inside the spreadsheets you already use — never a new platform, never a subscription.
Core
Reporting automation
Eliminate manual data entry from your weekly reports. Connect booking exports, invoices and rota files into one automated workflow.
Weekly activity, labour and cost reports refreshed without retyping
One view of spend, appointments and staffing across sites or rooms
Zero new software to buy — built in Excel or Google Sheets
Insight
Business dashboards
Transform scattered data into clear weekly views: appointments versus labour, margin and utilisation dashboards that update from your exports.
Site-by-site or practitioner-by-practitioner performance
Cost and revenue lines side by side
Shareable summaries for owners, practice managers and finance leads
Planning
Forecasting & planning
Simple demand and staffing forecasts your managers can follow and check — based on bookings, seasonality and your historical mix.
Line-level planning recommendations you can audit
Fewer last-minute rota and supply scrambles
Transparent logic anyone on the team can review
Control
Invoice processing
Supplier and contractor invoices checked against orders and deliveries so price changes, short shipments and duplicate charges are caught before payment.
Line-item price and quantity variance checks
Month-end reconciliation without the usual copy-paste scramble
See what a walkthrough covers below
AI
Data & AI reviews
Careful, practical AI for back-office reporting tasks — run alongside your existing process first. Not a substitute for clinical judgement.
Plain-language risk assessment for each reporting use-case
Pilot on low-risk admin tasks before any wider rollout
Human-in-the-loop by design, GDPR-conscious
Efficiency
Process optimisation
Find where your team’s hours actually go each week. Streamline month-end, stock or supplies counts and reporting across locations.
Time-based audit of weekly reporting work
Elimination of copy-paste handoffs between systems
Written standard operating notes you can keep

No cost · No obligation
Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute Weekly-Report Walkthrough
Show me one weekly report, and I will walk you through a few quick wins on the call. No new platform. No monthly subscription. Just practical improvements to the tools you already use.
Book the free walkthrough →
Or email me first
Sample work
What a walkthrough covers
A clear, no-obligation session focused on how your weekly numbers are assembled — not a demo of someone else's results.
Your weekly report
You share one weekly report on screen — a redacted copy is fine. We look at how the numbers are gathered today from booking, rota and finance exports.
Practical next steps
I walk through a few changes I would try first inside the spreadsheets you already own — no new platform, and nothing recorded.
Written summary
You receive a short written summary by email within two working days so your team can decide whether a deeper review is worth doing.
Boundaries
The conversation stays on reporting and data workflows. It is not clinical advice, treatment guidance or a compliance audit.
Typical sources we discuss
Booking diaries, rota files, till or billing exports, and invoice folders
The aim is a single spreadsheet you own that refreshes from those exports — so costs, appointments, staffing and revenue sit in one place without retyping each week.
Book the free walkthrough to talk through your report →

Why this exists
Most weekly operations reports are late, and nobody is sure they're right — because someone is still copying figures between systems by hand.
Today I build the spreadsheets that do that collation automatically, inside the tools you already own — no new platform, no subscription, and you keep everything I build. For health and wellness clients the scope is reporting and data workflows only.
